reviews.body_html: After a lot of comparison shopping, we decided to go with Peak Saunas for our in-home sauna purchase. The crate arrived as described in great shape, and assembly was relatively straightforward. The documentation and videos they sent us were also super helpful. Peak Saunas has been friendly and professional throughout the entire process.
